{{Short description|Mexican politician}}

[[File:Patricia Elena Aceves Pastrana (49544839232).jpg|thumb|Patricia Elena Aceves Pastrana]]
'''Patricia Elena Aceves Pastrana''' (born April 9, 1948) is a Mexican politician, member of the [[Morena (political party)|National Regeneration Movement]] party (MORENA).<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |date= |title=Dip. Patricia Elena Aceves Pastrana |url=https://sitllxiii.diputados.gob.mx/curricula.php?dipt=50 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221207210920/https://sitllxiii.diputados.gob.mx/curricula.php?dipt=50 |archive-date=2022-12-07 |access-date=2023-12-07 |website=sitl.diputados.gob.mx}}</ref> Born in [[Minatitlán, Veracruz|Minatitlán]], [[Veracruz]], she served as a [[Chamber of Deputies (Mexico)|federal deputy]] in the [[LXIII Legislature of the Mexican Congress|63rd Congress]] (2015–2018), representing [[Mexico City]]'s [[Fifth Federal Electoral District of Mexico City|fifth district]], and as the mayor of [[Tlalpan]] from 2018 to 2021.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=2018-04-03 |title=Patricia Elena Aceves Pastrana |url=https://www.excelsior.com.mx/comunidad/elecciones-2018-cdmx/candidato/patricia-elena-aceves-pastrana |access-date=2023-12-07 |website=Excélsior |language=es-MX}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Patricia Aceves Semblanza |url=https://bsqm.org.mx/pdf-boletines/V15/V15N2/BSQM211502_dPatricia_Aceves_Semblanza.pdf |website=bsqm.org.mx}}</ref> She was rector of the [[Universidad Autónoma Metropolitana|Metropolitan Autonomous University]] (UAM).<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=SIL - Sistema de Información Legislativa-PopUp Legislador |url=http://sil.gobernacion.gob.mx/Librerias/pp_PerfilLegislador.php?Referencia=9219658#Perfil |access-date=2023-12-07 |website=sil.gobernacion.gob.mx}}</ref>

== Academic life ==
She studied Pharmaceutical Chemistry and Biology (1965-1969), then completed a master's degree in History of Mexico, and finally received her PhD in [[Organic chemistry|Organic Chemistry]] from the [[Claude Bernard University Lyon 1|Claude Bernard University]] in [[Lyon]], [[France]].<ref name=":0" /> In 2000 she received an honorary doctorate from the [[Complutense University of Madrid]].<ref name=":0" /> She was a professor at [[Universidad Autónoma Metropolitana|Metropolitan Autonomous University]] (UAM) as well as at the [[School of Philosophy and Letters, UNAM|Faculty of Philosophy and Letters of the UNAM]].<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":0" /> She is currently a member of the [[Sistema Nacional de Investigadores|National System of Researchers]].<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":0" />

== Political career ==
{{Expand section|date=December 2025}}
Her political career began in 2012, within the [[Morena (political party)|National Regeneration Movement]] party (MORENA).<ref name=":1" />
